arxiv-2105-01857.title: Magnetic Properties of NbSi 2 N 4 , VSi 2 N 4 , and VSi 2 P 4 Monolayers
arxiv-2105-01857.creator: Md. Rakibul Karim Akanda, Roger K. Lake
arxiv-2105-01857.description: Abstract The recent demonstration of MoSi 2 N 4 and its exceptional stability to air, water, acid, and heat has generated intense interest in this family of two-dimensional (2D) materials. Among these materials, monolayers of NbSi 2 N 4 , VSi 2 N 4 , and VSi 2 P 4 are semiconducting, easy-plane ferromagnets with negligible in-plane magnetic anisotropy.

arxiv-2112-00717.title: Computation of Burgers Vectors from Elastic Strain and Lattice Rotation Data
arxiv-2112-00717.creator: J. Cloete 1, E. Tarleton 1,2 and F. Hofmann 1
arxiv-2112-00717.description: Abstract A theoretical framework for computation of Burgers vectors from strain and lattice rotation data in materials with low dislocation density is presented, as well as implementation into a computer program to automate the process. The efficacy of the method is verified using simulated data of dislocations with known results.

arxiv-2206-05530.title: Memorization-Dilation: Modeling Neural Collapse Under Label Noise
arxiv-2206-05530.creator: Duc Anh NguyenLMU Munich, Ron LevieTechnionIsrael Institute of Technology, Julian LienenPaderborn UniversityGitta KutyniokLMU MunichUniversity of TromsøEyke HüllermeierLMU Munich
arxiv-2206-05530.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Duc Anh NguyenLMU Munich, Ron LevieTechnionIsrael Institute of Technology, Julian LienenPaderborn UniversityGitta KutyniokLMU MunichUniversity of TromsøEyke HüllermeierLMU Munich. The notion of neural collapse refers to several emergent phenomena that have been empirically observed across various canonical classification problems. During the terminal phase of training a deep neural network, the feature embedding of all examples of the same class tend to collapse to a single representation, and the features of different classes tend to separate as much as possible.
